scope: Replace remaining NGE player combat-level reads across retained conversation and theme-park content with hidden PRE-CU skill-box progression while preserving authored quests, conversations, rewards, thresholds, and creature levels.

findings: Publish 14.1 characters progress through independently learned skill boxes and a 250-point skill budget, not an NGE class or visible combat level.
The authenticated retained-content bridge already maps learned PRE-CU combat-box point costs to a hidden 1-90 encounter scale without exposing a player level.
Trader and Entertainer content requires separate crafting and social skill-box adapters so noncombat progression remains usable without inflating creature combat difficulty.
Retained expansion content and its authored thresholds remain available, but NGE getLevel(player) is no longer authoritative on this surface.
